# Introduction {.unnumbered}


These notes focus on the practical workflow of supervised learning, including data splitting, cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and model evaluation. Using KNN as the main example, we explore these concepts through hands-on exercises and introduce tidymodels (R) and scikit-learn (Python) as frameworks for building reproducible machine learning pipelines. A short SVM example demonstrates how easily models can be swapped within these frameworks.

Learning outcomes

By the end of this session, participants should be able to:

- Explain the purpose of training, validation, and test datasets.
- Apply different data-splitting strategies, including cross-validation.
- Use cross-validation to tune hyperparameters and compare models.
- Recognize potential sources of data leakage and how to avoid them.
- Build reproducible machine learning pipelines using tidymodels (R) and scikit-learn (Python).
- Evaluate model performance on unseen test data.
- Swap algorithms within an existing pipeline, using KNN and SVM as examples.
